additional_info.subject: RE: ID0410322-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P8 170000896] MeterStart 0 in AC charging CRM:00643001328
additional_info.body:
Hi Bastien,
The meter reading starts at 0 in the startTransaction message, and in the stopTransaction message, it shows the energy consumed by the EV. This is 0 at the start because we don't have an AC meter implemented in the charger for that specific outlet to track the energy.
Please let us know if you have any further query to discuss if not we shall proceed with closing this ticket.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
